title: Recidivism
pdf_title: CHAPTER 9 RECIDIVISM 9.1 The information on ‘Recidivism’ was available in respect of 21,80,573 offenders during the year 1986 out of which 19,29,431 i.e., 88.5% were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and thrice or more was 9.0%, 1.6% and 0.9% respectively. It was found that 17.7% of the persons arrested for the offence of ‘Burglary’ were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of ‘Recidivism’ closely followed by ‘Culpable Homicide not amounting to Murder’ (17.0%), ‘Theft’ (16.0%) and ‘Dacoity’ (14.9%). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of ‘Recidivism’ are presented in Tables 53 and 54.
